# THE PULL-REQUEST FORMS OF THE NIGHTLY GATES (docs/CI-TIERS.md).
#
# A gate whose only workflow runs on a schedule or on dispatch checks nothing a
# pull request changes until the night after it lands: the strict Ruby gate
# ran only nightly, and a RuboCop offense reached main (2026-11-22). Each row
# here is the fast form of one such gate. ci-fast.yml runs it, as a row of its
# nightly-fast job, on any push or pull request that touches the row leg, or a
# path its paths pattern matches, or the broad rule; a diff to this file runs
# every row. Each row fits the two-minute job cap: its nightly job time on the
# fleet is in docs/CI-TIERS.md.
#
# Fields, separated by " | ":
#   name   the matrix row
#   leg    the toolchain the job sets up, and the plan leg that selects the row
#          ("-" for none)
#   paths  an extended regular expression; a changed path it matches selects
#          the row
#   run    the shell line the row runs, from the repository root, with the
#          pinned siblings at ../serialize* (the job clones them)
#
# internal/nightlyrows parses this file and picks the rows; internal/ci
# TestEveryNightlyOnlyGateHasAPRTierForm holds every nightly-only workflow to a
# row here or to a named ci-fast job, and every make target named here to a
# definition.

# the per-language hostile-input corpora (schema-<lang>-runs-hostile-corpus.yml)
hostile-c | c | (^|/)schema[-_]c[-_]runs[-_]hostile|^internal/ci/hostilecorpus/ | make schema-c-runs-hostile-corpus SERIALIZE_C=../serialize.c
hostile-cpp | cpp | (^|/)schema[-_]cpp[-_]runs[-_]hostile|^internal/ci/hostilecorpus/ | make schema-cpp-runs-hostile-corpus SERIALIZE=../serialize

hostile-go | go | (^|/)schema[-_]go[-_]runs[-_]hostile|^internal/ci/hostilecorpus/|^make/hostile-ledger\.mk$ | make schema-go-runs-hostile-corpus
hostile-dart | dart | (^|/)schema[-_]dart[-_]runs[-_]hostile|^internal/ci/hostilecorpus/ | make schema-dart-runs-hostile-corpus DART=dart

# THE FIXED FORM AND VERSIONING GATES, every leg (2026-11-24). They were
# ci-fast.yml's leg-gate matrix, which ran only on workflow_dispatch: per
# commit they ran never, and the nightly was the only place a leg's fixed form
# or its §5 versioning rows went red. Now a row each, selected by the leg like
# every row here. A gate that does not fit two minutes as one job is cut by
# construction, never by a hand list: versioning-<leg>-k runs shard k of the
# gate's own tests (make/go-test-shard.mk, tools/gotestshard), and an
# aggregate's rows run shard k of what make prints for it (tools/makeshard;
# -each holds one gate per row and is red when a gate is added without one).
# The C++ leg's sanitized half and its clean gates, the Rust probes, the
# Squirrel card parts and test-lobster stay the leg-gate-* jobs. Lua has no
# fixed-form or versioning gate to run (owed: docs/CI-TIERS.md).
fixedform-cpp | cpp | ^docs/FIXED-FORM-(ALGORITHM|VERSIONING-TESTS)\.md$|^test/fixedform/ | make -j"$(nproc)" tables-fixedform-plain
fixedform-go | go | ^docs/FIXED-FORM-(ALGORITHM|VERSIONING-TESTS)\.md$|^test/fixedform/ | make tables-go-fixed-form
versioning-go | go | ^docs/FIXED-FORM-(ALGORITHM|VERSIONING-TESTS)\.md$|^test/fixedform/ | make tables-go-versioning
fixedform-c | c | ^docs/FIXED-FORM-(ALGORITHM|VERSIONING-TESTS)\.md$|^test/fixedform/ | make tables-c-fixedform
versioning-c-1 | c | ^docs/FIXED-FORM-(ALGORITHM|VERSIONING-TESTS)\.md$|^test/fixedform/|^make/go-test-shard\.mk$|^tools/gotestshard/ | make tables-c-versioning GO_TEST_SHARD=1/5
versioning-c-2 | c | ^docs/FIXED-FORM-(ALGORITHM|VERSIONING-TESTS)\.md$|^test/fixedform/|^make/go-test-shard\.mk$|^tools/gotestshard/ | make tables-c-versioning GO_TEST_SHARD=2/5
versioning-c-3 | c | ^docs/FIXED-FORM-(ALGORITHM|VERSIONING-TESTS)\.md$|^test/fixedform/|^make/go-test-shard\.mk$|^tools/gotestshard/ | make tables-c-versioning GO_TEST_SHARD=3/5
versioning-c-4 | c | ^docs/FIXED-FORM-(ALGORITHM|VERSIONING-TESTS)\.md$|^test/fixedform/|^make/go-test-shard\.mk$|^tools/gotestshard/ | make tables-c-versioning GO_TEST_SHARD=4/5

# THE SHARED GATES' NEGATIVE CONTROLS, ONE ROTATING LEG (2026-11-24;
# make/widen-18-gate-controls.mk). Each gate's control plants its oracle wrong
# and requires a leg's own gate red; the night runs all 18 legs
# (make/negative-controls.json gate-controls-<gate>), and a diff to a shared
# harness runs each gate on one leg, GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER mod 18, a different leg
# each run. 144 jobs per pull request would be the queue of 2026-11-15 again.
controls-bitphase | - | ^test/(verify-(bitphase|canonical|tablegen)|conformance/harness)/|^make/(widen-18-gate-controls|verify-widen-18|verify-vm|verify-compiled)\.mk$|^tools/gatecontrol/ | make verify-gate-control-rotating GATE=bitphase
controls-canonical | - | ^test/(verify-(bitphase|canonical|tablegen)|conformance/harness)/|^make/(widen-18-gate-controls|verify-widen-18|verify-vm|verify-compiled)\.mk$|^tools/gatecontrol/ | make verify-gate-control-rotating GATE=canonical
controls-tablegen | - | ^test/(verify-(bitphase|canonical|tablegen)|conformance/harness)/|^make/(widen-18-gate-controls|verify-widen-18|verify-vm|verify-compiled)\.mk$|^tools/gatecontrol/ | make verify-gate-control-rotating GATE=tablegen
controls-message-fuzz | - | ^test/(verify-(bitphase|canonical|tablegen)|conformance/harness)/|^make/(widen-18-gate-controls|verify-widen-18|verify-vm|verify-compiled)\.mk$|^tools/gatecontrol/ | make verify-gate-control-rotating GATE=message-fuzz
controls-sabotage-packet | - | ^test/(verify-(bitphase|canonical|tablegen)|conformance/harness)/|^make/(widen-18-gate-controls|verify-widen-18|verify-vm|verify-compiled)\.mk$|^tools/gatecontrol/ | make verify-gate-control-rotating GATE=sabotage-packet
controls-sabotage-fixed | - | ^test/(verify-(bitphase|canonical|tablegen)|conformance/harness)/|^make/(widen-18-gate-controls|verify-widen-18|verify-vm|verify-compiled)\.mk$|^tools/gatecontrol/ | make verify-gate-control-rotating GATE=sabotage-fixed
controls-sabotage-variable | - | ^test/(verify-(bitphase|canonical|tablegen)|conformance/harness)/|^make/(widen-18-gate-controls|verify-widen-18|verify-vm|verify-compiled)\.mk$|^tools/gatecontrol/ | make verify-gate-control-rotating GATE=sabotage-variable
controls-sabotage-retain | - | ^test/(verify-(bitphase|canonical|tablegen)|conformance/harness)/|^make/(widen-18-gate-controls|verify-widen-18|verify-vm|verify-compiled)\.mk$|^tools/gatecontrol/ | make verify-gate-control-rotating GATE=sabotage-retain
